sentence: This project studies which genes let bacteria break free from the sticky matrix of a biofilm and how those freed cells change.
This project tests two versions of a web-based craving training that help people who smoke cigarettes quit, and studies how they work.
This project studies how different ligands cause different responses in a receptor by way of endocytosis, in cancers such as lung cancer.
This project studies how acute pancreatitis becomes severe and tries to build a blood test that tells which patients will get worse.
This project studies how two genes are switched on in skin cells that turn into squamous cell carcinomas.
This project studies how fucosylation by gut microbiota shapes the gut immune system and adds to alcohol-associated liver disease.
This project uses residual specimens from children with COVID-19 to study co-infection with other respiratory viruses and its effects on the immune response.
This project provides bioinformatics and biostatistics support for cancer research and builds tools that show and interpret molecular data.
This project studies how a pathway involving an altered gene helps lung adenocarcinoma spread, and looks for ways to target it.
This project studies programmed DNA elimination in a model organism to learn how genomes are maintained.
This project develops a platform of accessible technologies that measure transcriptomics and chromatin together in cells with spatial resolution.
This project builds a tool from small antibody-like proteins called nanobodies that can be switched on or off inside living cells.
This project studies how T cells that recognize past viruses work inside tumors and looks for ways to make them stronger.
This project develops a cryopreservation medium that helps NK cells keep their ability to migrate and kill after thawing.
This project studies small cell lung cancer using single cell profiling and genome editing of human tumors to find drug targets.
This project tests a genomic panel to find high-risk anal pre-cancers in people living with HIV and looks for markers of recurrence.
This project studies how herpes simplex virus type 1 causes membrane fusion during infection.
This project builds language and speech tools to study how exposures relate to cognitive decline in people who responded to a disaster.
This project manages and checks the brain scans, including MRI and PET, used to study Alzheimer disease risk in a large study.
This project studies how stem cells in the Drosophila midgut stop growing and how the extracellular matrix changes when regeneration ends.
